newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rugby union-Du Plessis named as new Springbok coach.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Du Plessis named as new Springbok coach.

text.p: Carel du Plessis, one of the greatest wings in South African history, was named on Tuesday as the new Springbok coach in place of Andre Markgraaff.
Du Plessis, 36, has never coached a club or provincial side but accompanied the Springboks on their tour of Argentina and Europe late last year as a tactical adviser.
His appointment was announced by South African Rugby Football Union spokesman Alex Broun.
Markgraaff resigned last week after admitting making insulting racial remarks about black sports officials in a secretly taped conversation.
